lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，腐肉散发恶臭。
我一步步蹭着墙皮往前走。
lines.en: I scrape along the wall one step at a time.

lines.zh: 摸索寻找可食用的尸体。

lines.en: Dragging one leg, I shuffle on.
My nails scrape along the wall.

lines.zh: 我面朝墙站了很久，没眨眼。
lines.en: I've faced this wall a long time without blinking.

lines.zh: 口水滴在胸口，我也懒得擦。
lines.en: Drool drips down my chest, and I don't bother wiping.
Bloody foam gurgles in my throat.
Head tilted, I stare into the distance.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作，我看得清。
lines.en: I see clearly when you raise your hand.

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I tilt my neck and look you up and down.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还在动，我记住了。
lines.en: Your eyes still move — I'll remember them.
I still remember how to walk.

lines.zh: 小腿折成两截，我拖着走。
lines.en: My calf snaps in two, and I drag it.

lines.zh: 肠子空得贴在背上，难受。
lines.en: My guts lie flat and empty, and it hurts.
The bolt struck rotten flesh, of all things.

lines.zh: 箭杆挂在我肩头，晃来晃去。
lines.en: The arrow shaft sways from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 紫色的火在我胸口烧出个洞。
lines.en: Purple fire burns a hole in my chest.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推到墙上，骨头散架。
lines.en: The blast slams me into the wall and rattles my bones.

lines.zh: 这一跤，我半边身子都麻了。
lines.en: That fall numbed half my body.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉体在呼唤着你。

lines.en: Come closer, and you'll get more.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，比你还香。
lines.en: That meat in your hand smells better than you.

lines.zh: 你的痛苦将转化为我的力量。

lines.en: Embrace the loneliness of this wasteland.

lines.zh: 我的骨头卡在门框里，过不去。
lines.en: My bones catch in the doorframe, and I can't pass.

lines.zh: 避开我，否则你会被撕碎。
lines.en: Get out of my way, or you'll be torn apart.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞歪了我的下巴。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked my jaw crooked.

lines.zh: 你靴子踩到我的脚，我抬手。
lines.en: Your boot lands on my foot, and my hand comes up.

lines.zh: 不要挡在我和目标之间。
我站不稳，手臂先伸出去。
lines.en: I can't stand straight — my arm reaches first.
Our strength can be greater together.
We are kindred spirits, we should join forces.
Only a few teeth left in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从远处就能感受到你。
lines.en: I can feel you from afar.

lines.zh: 我的力量在你身上显现。

lines.en: I already went through the chest for you.

lines.zh: 这只鞋我穿着正好，归我。
lines.en: This shoe fits me; it's mine.
My strength can tear you apart.
The taste of death is so alluring.
Another piece of meat that walks.

lines.zh: 这片废墟里，只有你在动。
lines.en: In these ruins, you're the only thing moving.
Smells like people ahead — walking over.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我隔着墙闻见。
lines.en: I smell your warmth through the wall.

lines.zh: 你这点体温，隔墙都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell your warmth through the wall.

lines.zh: 你钻进雾里，我跟着味道转。
lines.en: You vanish into the fog, and I turn to your scent.
My bite marks will stay on you.
There are still living in the ruins.

lines.zh: 你将为我的存在付出代价。
lines.en: You will pay for my existence.

lines.zh: 疼痛会跟我一起找上你。
lines.en: Pain will come looking for you with me.
I count the steps you have left.

lines.zh: 你握兵器的手在抖，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your weapon hand shakes, and I smell it.
You will rise again, like me.
The more you run, the more you bleed.
My teeth are dull, but enough.
You'll turn into a walker too.

lines.zh: 你闻到我身上的味道了吗？
我掐住你的喉咙，指甲陷进去。
lines.en: I grip your throat, nails digging in.
A severed hand grips even tighter.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，只咬到你的衣领。
lines.en: I bite down and catch only your collar.
I spread my arms and lunge.
I sink my teeth into your arm!
I knock you to the ground!
Why tremble? I'm not done biting.

lines.zh: 瓦砾堆里埋着半具尸体，正好。
lines.en: Half a corpse lies under the rubble — perfect.
I stand up out of the corpse pile.

lines.zh: 街角多了一个摇摇晃晃的影子。
lines.en: Another staggering shape on the corner.

lines.zh: 火爬过我的袖子，皮在卷。
lines.en: Fire climbs my sleeve, and my skin curls.

lines.zh: 从断墙上摔下，骨头又错一节。
lines.en: I fell from a broken wall and slipped another joint.

lines.zh: 水从我的破喉咙灌进去。
lines.en: Water pours in through my torn throat.

lines.zh: 碎片扎进我的腿，我照走。
lines.en: Shards lodge in my leg, and I keep walking.
An arrow in my chest, and I'm still walking...

lines.zh: 饿到最后，连痛都不记得。
lines.en: Starved so long, I forget the pain.
White light runs through me and I rise again.
